title: Fast Money Auto Buy Printers Teleports Auto Everything
features:
💰 Auto Sell

AutoSell auto-collect cash from all your SellParts.

Live stats showing money, sellpart count, and total collected.

🛒 Auto Buy

Toggle auto-buy the best printer (by $/sec) every X seconds.

Choose mode: "Best" or "Specific Printer" (by name or ID).

Auto‑place bought printers on your plot (optional).

Auto‑Restock burst – when shop restocks, spam‑buy up to 30 printers.

Buy counter tracks purchases.

🏪 Shop Tab

Top 10 printers sorted by $/sec, showing stock, cost, and rebirth lock.

Buy Best Now – instant purchase.

Buy Best 10x – rapid buy spree.

💰 Sell Items

Sell Selected Printer – choose from a dropdown of all printers.

Sell All Printers – sells every printer you own (by ID).

Sell by ID Range – specify a range (e.g., 0–10) to sell any items (printers, belts, etc.).

📍 Teleport Tab

My Plot – teleport to your own plot.

Shop Area – jump to the shop zone.

Sell Area – teleport to your first SellPart.

Spawn – go to the main spawn point.

Other Plots – refresh player list and teleport to any player’s plot by Username.

🛠️ Tools

Walk Speed

Jump Power

Anti‑AFK – prevents idle kicks.

Auto‑Rejoin – automatically reconnects

Rejoin Server button.

Remove All My Printers – wipes your droppers

Debug – print top printers or plot info to console.

⚙️ General

All intervals adjustable via sliders.

Live stats update in real time.
